_note: Words for attachments, download links and templates in the composer. Edit the wording here. {used}, {limit}, {name}, {count}, {date} and {max} are filled in by the app.
loadFailed: Couldn't add this. Remove it and try again.
tooBig: This email is too big to send. Cloudflare allows {limit} of attachments with this message. Remove an attachment, or send it in a separate email.
tooBigServer: This email is too big to send. Cloudflare allows up to 5 MB per email, including attachments. Remove an attachment, or send it in a separate email.
stillAdding: Wait for your attachments to finish adding, then press Send.
forwardedNote: The original email's attachments are included. Remove any you don't want to send.
linkBadgeTitle: Too big to attach, so this goes as a download link
linksNoteOne: 1 file is too big to attach, so it will go as a download link that lasts 30 days.
linksNote: {count} files are too big to attach, so they will go as download links that last 30 days.
linksProtect: Protect download links with a password
linksPasswordHint: Send the password to the recipient separately, not in this email.
linksShareMessage: Here's the password for the files I've just emailed you: {password}
linksPasswordShort: Use a password of at least 8 characters for the download links.
linksOff: Files this big need download links, which aren't switched on yet. The README shows how to switch them on.
picturesTooBig: The pictures in this message make it too big to send. Remove one, or attach the pictures instead of putting them in the message.
linkTooBig: {name} is too big to send, even as a download link. The largest file you can send is {max}.
linksNotInDrafts: Draft saved. Files too big to attach aren't kept in drafts, so add them again before sending.
linksBoxTitleOne: File shared with a download link
linksBoxPassword: The files are password protected. The sender will give you the password separately.
templatesManage: Add or change templates in Settings
fromLabel: Which of your addresses this email is from
